scope: source audit; no live MAA/config/runner source was changed

native16.semantic_result: native SPD destination; FP64 uses a paired visible tile

native4.semantic_result: only a 4K physical page can be stored at once

transparent_hybrid4.verdict: not a self-contained 4K payload: it uses separate 4K-value FP64 input/output pages plus a 16K-value coherent producer backing span

bounded4.external_descriptor_payload_formula: sum(ceil_to_64(6 * population[pass])) for the three nonresident passes
bounded4.verdict: bounded on-chip metadata/control, but A[B[i]] still persists in shared coherent backing

finite_on_chip_or_private_state.row_table_entries_formula: active_slices * rows_per_slice * entries_per_row; entry fields are Addr + first_itr + last_itr (ABI/padding-dependent host bytes)
finite_on_chip_or_private_state.offset_table_entries: num_offset_table_entries; default resolves to logical_tile_elements, and bounded operation closes epochs at its configured limit
finite_on_chip_or_private_state.response_pool_default_formula: virtual_response_slots * 64 bytes = 8 * 64 = 512 bytes before C++ vector/object overhead; runner profile is 96 slots plus a 480-word pooled useful-data limit
finite_on_chip_or_private_state.combiner_default_formula: virtual_combine_slots * 64 bytes = 16 * 64 = 1024 bytes before metadata; runner profile is 384 slots / configured 4096 words
finite_on_chip_or_private_state.direct_index_feeder: at most virtual_index_buffer_lines 64-byte B lines, plus one DirectIndexWord record per admitted word; runner sets four lines
finite_on_chip_or_private_state.descriptor_spool: four 64-byte staging lines, up to five carry bytes each, <=16 write credits and <=4 outstanding read lines; external descriptors are timing-visible backing, not on-chip payload
finite_on_chip_or_private_state.logical_spd_cache_separate_path: LogicalSPDCacheRuntime has accounting-only private payload 2 * 2048 * 8 = 32768 bytes per MAA. It is a separate opcode path and must not be silently counted as the virtual-index hybrid SPD payload.

liveness.b_index_copy: dead after row/offset admission for the normal direct-index path: discardDirectIndex erases direct_index_words after DescriptorInserted. Exception: the bounded descriptor-spool path deliberately serializes (logical iteration, B value) as a 6-byte external descriptor for later replay.
liveness.a_of_b_result: must persist for the virtual consumer: source-response words enter the combiner and retirement writes target backingWordAddr(itr); the benchmark transparent consumer receives backing and destination pointers.
